prompt: 把這個立方體展開圖折起來,哪一個敘述是錯的?(只有一個不可能)

visual.html: <svg width='160' height='200' viewBox='0 0 160 200'><g transform='translate(20,20)'><rect x='40' y='0' width='40' height='40' fill='white' stroke='#2D2A4A' stroke-width='2.5'/><circle cx='60' cy='20' r='6' fill='#FF6B9D'/><rect x='40' y='40' width='40' height='40' fill='white' stroke='#2D2A4A' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='60' y='68' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-weight='900' fill='#4ECDC4'>★</text><rect x='40' y='80' width='40' height='40' fill='white' stroke='#2D2A4A' stroke-width='2.5'/><rect x='50' y='90' width='20' height='20' fill='#FFD93D'/><rect x='40' y='120' width='40' height='40' fill='white' stroke='#2D2A4A' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='60' y='148' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-weight='900' fill='#9B7EDE'>▲</text><rect x='0' y='80' width='40' height='40' fill='white' stroke='#2D2A4A' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='20' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-size='20' fill='#FF9F45'>●</text><rect x='80' y='80' width='40' height='40' fill='white' stroke='#2D2A4A' stroke-width='2.5'/><text x='100' y='108' text-anchor='middle' font-size='20' fill='#5B9DEC'>◆</text></g></svg>

options.text: 粉●在頂,★在後,▲在前 (前後相對)

hint: 找展開圖的十字交叉:黃■在中央,周圍是★(上)、▲(下)、橘●(左)、藍◆(右)。折起來時黃■是底面,周圍 4 個變成四個側面。最上面的粉●呢?跟著★一起再折一次,會落到頂面。
explanation: 折起來後:中央的黃■是底面、最上面的粉●是頂面(粉●和黃■相對 ✓)。圍著黃■的四個側面是 ★、▲、橘●、藍◆。其中★和▲相對(它們在中央列的上下兩端,折起來變成前後牆)、橘●和藍◆相對(在中央列的左右兩端,折起來變成左右牆)。所以「★和黃■相對」是錯的——它們在展開圖上其實是相鄰(共用一條摺邊)。
